projects.title: Autonomous Agricultural Robot Simulation Stack
projects.description: A full-fidelity simulation stack for an autonomous agricultural robot featuring Double Ackermann (4WS/4WD) steering. The platform leverages NVIDIA Isaac Sim for photorealistic, physics-based simulation and the NVIDIA Isaac ROS ecosystem for GPU-accelerated perception, mapping, and navigation.
details: Photorealistic simulation — USD-based agricultural environment in NVIDIA Isaac Sim with realistic terrain, lighting (HDRI), and physics
GPU-accelerated stereo vision — Multi-camera ESS (Edge-aware Stereo Similarity) disparity and depth estimation
Visual SLAM — NVIDIA cuVSLAM for GPU-accelerated visual odometry, mapping, and relocalization
Dynamic obstacle masking — YOLO-based segmentation to filter dynamic objects from depth maps
